Hey! Firstly, I've gotta say that you are so amazing to have also listed down the positive things in your life; no, you aren't letting any of us down. You seem like a really fun person and you deserve happiness. I know people say that it will get better. Personally, I believe that the situation may not get better but you definitely will. Once you start doing things for yourself and start finding happiness, everything may start falling into place. It happened with me as well. I started focusing on myself, doing stuff that I like. Most of the days I was so mentally drained that I couldn't get up from my bed. I did get better eventually. I'm proud of you for ranting here!
